title.en: CI-reported run detail shows progress and cases
title.uk: Деталі CI-рану показують прогрес і кейси
title.fr: Le détail d'un run CI affiche la progression et les cas
title.es: El detalle de un run CI muestra progreso y casos

description.en: After Playwright/CI posts results, Runs → run detail must show Progress N/N and case rows (not 0/0).
description.uk: Після ingest результатів Runs → деталі рану показують Progress N/N і рядки кейсів (не 0/0).
description.fr: After Playwright/CI posts results, Runs → run detail must show Progress N/N and case rows (not 0/0).
description.es: After Playwright/CI posts results, Runs → run detail must show Progress N/N and case rows (not 0/0).
description.de: After Playwright/CI posts results, Runs → run detail must show Progress N/N and case rows (not 0/0).

precondition.en: Project with at least one case; CI open → results → close completed.
precondition.uk: Проєкт із хоча б одним кейсом; CI open → results → close виконано.
precondition.fr: Project with at least one case; CI open → results → close completed.
precondition.es: Project with at least one case; CI open → results → close completed.
precondition.de: Project with at least one case; CI open → results → close completed.

action.en: Open a CI run via POST /ci/runs, post a passed result for a known case_key, close the run, then open Runs → that run in the UI.
action.uk: Відкрити CI-ран через POST /ci/runs, надіслати passed для case_key, закрити, відкрити Runs → цей ран у UI.
action.fr: Open a CI run via POST /ci/runs, post a passed result for a known case_key, close the run, then open Runs → that run in the UI.
action.es: Open a CI run via POST /ci/runs, post a passed result for a known case_key, close the run, then open Runs → that run in the UI.
action.de: Open a CI run via POST /ci/runs, post a passed result for a known case_key, close the run, then open Runs → that run in the UI.

expected_result.en: run-detail-progress shows 1/1 (not 0/0); run-detail-case-row lists the matched case with Passed.
expected_result.uk: run-detail-progress показує 1/1 (не 0/0); run-detail-case-row містить matched кейс зі статусом Passed.
expected_result.fr: run-detail-progress shows 1/1 (not 0/0); run-detail-case-row lists the matched case with Passed.
expected_result.es: run-detail-progress shows 1/1 (not 0/0); run-detail-case-row lists the matched case with Passed.
expected_result.de: run-detail-progress shows 1/1 (not 0/0); run-detail-case-row lists the matched case with Passed.
